corrections.why: The register text says the lookout returned to service with volunteer hosts in October 1998. The brief took the 1999 date from elsewhere. The foundation's 1999 date conflicts, so the record should show the register date with the conflict noted.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the FFLA chapter say 1936. The foundation says 1937 and credits the Civilian Conservation Corps. The story reports both.
The register says volunteer hosts returned in October 1998. The foundation says it re-opened in 1999.
The register gives 4,536 ft (1,383 m); the foundation gives 4,573 ft. The record keeps 1382.6 m.

notes_for_editor: The fire and the loss are well documented (FFLA report, CAL FIRE, two FFLA pages). No source describes the site after the fire, so access is left unset rather than guessed. The brief lists both burned and destroyed for 2022; they are the same event, so merge them. The name spelling San Bernadino comes from the NHLR title and slug; the forest is the San Bernardino National Forest. Social-media and chamber-of-commerce snippets about the fire were not cited because they were not read as pages.
